items.title: claude-mem holds #1 on trending as its run cools to 1,527 stars today
items.summary:
claude-mem gives coding agents memory that survives between sessions, capturing work and compressing it for later.
108,758 stars total, +1,527 today, TypeScript, still the top repo on github's daily chart.

items.title: t3code jumps to 3,100 stars today, the biggest single-day gain on the chart
items.summary:
t3code is a code-first chat app from the t3 stack crowd, and it now sits #4 on github trending and #3 on trendshift.
37,036 stars total, +3,100 today, TypeScript, with the repo pushed minutes before this build.

items.title: hex adds 1,329 stars for dictation that never leaves the machine
items.summary:
hex is a local-first macos dictation app: hold a shortcut, speak, and the text lands in whatever app you are in, with speech recognition on-device.
2,831 stars total, +1,329 today, Rust, #12 on github trending and #7 on trendshift.

items.title: kronos climbs back to #3 with 611 stars for a markets foundation model
items.summary:
kronos is a pretrained model trained on candlestick data, built to forecast price moves across markets instead of reading text.
45,094 stars total, +611 today, Python, and the repo has not been pushed since april.

items.title: claude-code-game-studios adds 970 stars for a 49-agent studio
items.summary:
the repo turns claude code into a game studio with 49 agents and 72 workflow skills.
31,871 stars total, +970 today, Shell, #8 on trending.

items.title: openmausbot adds 919 stars for a self-hosted bot team
items.summary:
openmausbot is an open-source grok bot alternative that gives each bot a virtual machine to work in.
10,288 stars total, +919 today, TypeScript, #5 on trending.

items.title: lightpanda adds 827 stars for an ai-first headless browser
items.summary:
lightpanda is a headless browser built for agents and automation rather than rendering pages for people.
39,809 stars total, +827 today, Zig, #2 on trending.

items.title: deepseek's dsh-superagent still leads trendshift at 3,800 stars
items.summary:
deepseek-ai's dsh-superagent-prototype is a TypeScript push toward a more autonomous agent system, and it has not left trendshift's #1 spot.
6,271 stars total, about 3,800 of them in the last day, and it is still missing from github's own daily chart.

items.title: iran cuts its hormuz offer to two days and waits on washington
items.summary:
araghchi told al jazeera that two days of qatari-mediated talks brought tehran's reopening timeline down from seven days, and that the next move is washington's.
rezaei says vance's letter has a 'positive tone' but lists five conditions first: end the blockade, oil waivers, unfrozen assets, a regional truce and an iran-oman hormuz arrangement.
items.change: tehran shortened its own hormuz timeline from seven days to two, aired footage of missiles leaving underground storage, and a treasury brief leaked to axios says no crude has loaded at iran's terminals since 25 august.

items.title: trump says the us can hit iran's last sites 'in 10 minutes'
items.summary:
trump told reporters at mar-a-lago that one or two sites remain, naming pickaxe mountain, and that the us has a plan it can execute quickly.
he spoke to netanyahu hours earlier, and the wall street journal reports washington is preparing to resume strikes after tuesday's midterms.
items.change: trump put a clock on the threat, ten minutes for the remaining nuclear sites, and confirmed a call with netanyahu before the vote.

items.title: reuters maps 5,000 iranian mod front agencies beating the blockade
items.summary:
a reuters investigation traced at least $2bn of rocket propellants, explosives, drone parts and launcher trucks imported since january 2025 through agencies named mod.
the network shares the defence ministry's tehran address, and much of the hardware was recorded as coming from china, russia and germany.
items.change: new: the first detailed map of how iran restocks missiles and drones while under a naval blockade.

items.title: an lpg tanker takes three hits south of lavan island
items.summary:
ukmto says three iranian projectiles struck a gas carrier about 40 nautical miles south of lavan on saturday, deep in the gulf rather than at the strait's mouth.
october was the worst month for attacks on hormuz transits since the war began, and tehran says ships must clear its persian gulf strait authority first.
items.change: the attacks moved off the strait itself, with a gas carrier hit near lavan, and october closed as the worst month for transits.

items.title: saudi-led coalition runs a 'precision operation' on houthi support assets
items.summary:
the coalition said it hit the logistics and maritime assets the houthis use to keep firing at the kingdom, and released footage of the strikes.
houthi media answered with fresh threats against saudi oil facilities and aviation, and accused the coalition of hitting a medical school.
items.change: new: a named coalition operation against houthi supply lines rather than single intercepts, with houthi threats renewed within hours.

items.title: the uae says it wants a breakthrough with iran and is ready for the worst
items.summary:
anwar gargash told the manama dialogue that gulf security is interconnected, that trust with iran has been shaken, and that abu dhabi does not want another round of confrontation.
he also said the emirates are prepared for a worst case and want hormuz back to how it was before 28 february.
items.change: new: the uae's most explicit public call yet for a deal, made at the region's main security summit.

items.title: saudi gdp shrinks 3.8% as the oil economy falls a fifth
items.summary:
preliminary data put third-quarter gdp 3.8% below a year earlier, with the oil sector down 20.4% and non-oil growth at 1.9%.
the drop is smaller than the 4.7% contraction in the second quarter, but the war has now cost two straight quarters of output.
items.change: new: the first gdp print since the houthi campaign on saudi soil began, and it is still a contraction.

items.title: herzog presses party leaders for flexibility as coalition talks open
items.summary:
israel's president used the first day of consultations to push both blocs to bend, with likud on 27 seats and the anti-netanyahu bloc on 53 against 48.
a netanyahu ally floated trump and herzog as guarantors of a unity government with eisenkot, an idea eisenkot has not signed up to.
items.change: the argument moved from the street to the president's residence, and a netanyahu ally is now floating a unity government with eisenkot.

items.title: opec+ leaves december quotas alone and defers the 2027 call
items.summary:
the group kept its december production targets unchanged on sunday, with the harder decision on 2027 volumes still ahead.
brent's january contract was last at $113.43 after december settled at $117.64 on friday, with hormuz risk still doing the work.

items.title: futures reopen at 02:00 riyadh, with ism, apple and the midterms next
items.summary:
cme futures reopen at 6pm new york time after the weekend, with ism manufacturing at 18:00 riyadh and 54.7 expected, then apple, palantir, vertex and on semiconductor after the close.
the midterms are tuesday, jolts follows on wednesday, and friday brings payrolls with 65,000 jobs and 4.2% unemployment expected.

items.title: 50m early votes cast as investors price a split congress
items.summary:
al jazeera puts early voting above 50 million with two days to go, while cnbc reports the muni bond market is already repositioning for a changed congress.
outside money is doing the talking: $637m from pop-up super pacs and more than $200m from the crypto industry.

items.title: binance reopens withdrawals and says it covers 90% of the $6.3bn
items.summary:
binance resumed customer withdrawals on sunday and said about 90% of stolen user assets are already covered, with the rest still being worked through.
the fbi has blamed north korean state hackers for the theft, the largest in crypto history.

items.title: s&p 500 falls 1.8% and the nasdaq 2.9% to end a rough october
items.summary:
the s&p 500 closed at 7,580.07, down 1.82%, and the nasdaq at 25,437.00, down 2.86%, while the dow lost 1.09% to 51,770.31.
the vix jumped 12.9% to 19.42 as tech led the selling.

items.title: intel closes down 28.6% in its worst day since 1974
items.summary:
intel fell to $65.76 after weak fourth-quarter guidance, losing nearly 30% of its market value in a session.
the drop is the stock's worst single day in 52 years.

items.title: reddit drops 29% as google's ai search cuts referrals
items.summary:
reddit closed at $91.73, down 29.2%, after a weak fourth-quarter forecast and a report that google's ai search cut more than a million weekly referrals.
analysts said the traffic hit is not fully priced in yet.

items.title: liverpool host arsenal at anfield in half an hour
items.summary:
kick-off is 19:30 riyadh, the last of four straight home games, with arsenal arriving as champions and joint-leaders and liverpool chasing a sixth win in a row.
arsenal have not won at anfield in the league since 2012, and a liverpool win cuts the gap at the top to three points.

items.title: confirmed: nyoni starts, szoboszlai and munoz make the bench
items.summary:
liverpool: alisson; araujo, jacquet, van dijk, kerkez; nyoni, mac allister; barcola, wirtz, gakpo; isak, seven changes from midweek.
arsenal: raya; timber, konsa, gabriel, calafiori; rice, guimaraes, odegaard; madueke, havertz, tzolis, with rice, calafiori and madueke all passed fit.

meta.debut: trey nyoni, first premier league start

items.title: szoboszlai and munoz are fit enough for the bench
items.summary:
both travelled and both made the squad after hamstring and knee issues, though iraola kept them among the substitutes.
frimpong, bradley, ekitike and leoni remain out, while arsenal are still without saka and saliba.

items.title: trent is third choice at real madrid and carragher would take him back
items.summary:
mourinho says trent accepted being left out and started him against racing santander on sunday, but carragher calls him third-choice right-back behind dumfries and a midfielder.
the echo also reports liverpool expect two departures in 2027; treat the anfield return talk as punditry, not a club plan.

meta.reliability: echo reporting plus pundit speculation, no club confirmation

items.title: mac allister says his future is still open as the contract wait drags
items.summary:
the midfielder, out of contract in 2028, said nothing has changed since he admitted he was sad not to be offered a new deal.
he pointed to the new sporting director and incoming minority ownership as reasons an extension could still happen.

items.title: bournemouth at home in the carabao cup quarter-finals
items.summary:
liverpool will host bournemouth in the last eight after beating chelsea on penalties in the previous round.
arsenal are already out after losing to fleetwood.

items.title: ancelotti leaves alisson out of brazil's november squad again
items.summary:
brazil coach carlo ancelotti said he does not need to test alisson and will call him for the copa america instead.
alisson will sit out the november friendlies against japan and singapore.
